new_capability_excluded.tools/it5_readthrough.py:holdout: the external check: refit without a measured context, predict it, compare

assumptions: a line of a new case card is configuration; a line in a shared module or driver is code. Blank lines and docstrings are counted, because a card is read by a person and its prose is part of the cost. portability_and_refactor_lines is the remainder after the declared new capability and moved files are removed, so it still contains the churn of splitting a driver that the repo's 400-line module gate forced; the entry quotes the cleaner pre-split figures (112 / 45 / 114) beside it
limitations: line counts are a proxy for effort, not effort; a one-line change can be harder than a hundred. The comparison with entry 156's 378-line driver is like for like only in that both counts are lines a person had to write
